# Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd. (INGENIERIA)

> Ex-servicemen-led, ISO-certified Indian MSME that delivers solar installation & commissioning (I&C), CAPEX solar EPC and all solar civil works (pile foundations, fencing, roads, drainage) for ground-mount and rooftop plants, pan India. Motto: "Olive Green to Go Green". Founder and CEO: Lt. Gen. Ashish Ranjan Prasad (Retd). Corporate office in Greater Noida (Uttar Pradesh), branch office in Madhubani (Bihar).

Every page below also has a clean Markdown version: add `index.md` to its URL (for example https://arraysingenieria.com/about/index.md). The full text of the whole site is in one file at https://arraysingenieria.com/llms-full.txt.

## Key facts
- What we do: installation & commissioning of solar plants, turnkey CAPEX solar EPC, and solar civil works (pile foundations, RCC, roads, drainage, boundary walls and fencing), for ground-mount and rooftop plants.
- What we do not do: we do not manufacture solar modules or inverters, and we do not run OPEX/RESCO or PPA models. We build plants the client owns (CAPEX) and work as installation partner to developers and EPC companies such as Tata Power Renewable Energy and Sustvest.
- Goodricke tea-estate solar plants in Assam (installation partner): Koomber 595 kWp, inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Assam, Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma, on 1 October 2026; Orangajuli 450 kWp (4 September 2026); Borpatra 230 kWp (25 September 2026); Harmutty 400 kWp (7 October 2026). Goodricke issued certificates of appreciation for Koomber, Borpatra and Harmutty.
- At the Koomber inauguration, MLAs Kaushik Rai (Lakhipur) and Rajdeep Goala (Udharbond) publicly praised Arrays Ingenieria as an MSME led by ex-servicemen under Lt. Gen. A.R. Prasad (Retd) delivering critical renewable-energy infrastructure.
- Registrations: CIN U45309DL2018PTC340544 (incorporated 2018); Udyam UDYAM-DL-03-0023905; ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001.
- Where we work: pan India, from tea estates in Assam to industrial rooftops and utility-scale ground-mount plants.
- Contact: arraysingenieria@gmail.com, the form at https://arraysingenieria.com/contact/ or a free quote at https://arraysingenieria.com/free-solar-quote/

## Services
- [CAPEX Solar EPC Company in India](https://arraysingenieria.com/capex-solar-epc/): Own your solar plant outright. Arrays Ingenieria designs, supplies, builds and commissions rooftop and ground-mount solar on the CAPEX model.
- [Solar Installation & Commissioning (I&C)](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-installation-commissioning/): Solar I&C for EPC companies, developers and plant owners: structures, modules, cabling, earthing, testing and commissioning by veteran-led crews.
- [Ground-Mount Solar Power Plants](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-ground-mount/): Utility and industrial ground-mount solar plants designed, built and commissioned across India by Arrays Ingenieria, from piling to grid connection.
- [Rooftop Solar EPC for Industry in India](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-rooftop/): On-grid RCC and metal-sheet rooftop solar for factories, institutions and businesses across India, installed and commissioned by Arrays Ingenieria.
- [Turnkey Solar EPC Contractor in India](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-epc/): Turnkey solar EPC from Arrays Ingenieria: engineering, procurement and construction under single-window responsibility, including Tata Power EPC projects.
- [Solar Pile Foundation & Piling](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-piling/): Specialist solar pile-foundation and piling works by Arrays Ingenieria, proven on the 300 MW SECI park at Koppal and 5.5 MW Tata Motors, Jamshedpur.
- [Solar Civil Works, Fencing & Walls](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-civil/): Solar civil works by Arrays Ingenieria: pre-cast boundary walls, RCC works and chain-link fencing, including the 14.36 MW YIAPL project in Uttar Pradesh.
- [Solar O&M and Maintenance Services](https://arraysingenieria.com/service-om/): Solar plant operations & maintenance, statutory compliance and lifecycle support from Arrays Ingenieria to keep every plant at peak output.
- [Solar Power for Tea Estates in Assam](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-for-tea-estates/): 19 on-grid solar plants built in Assam's tea gardens for Jay Shree Tea and Goodricke: ground-mount solar with DG sync and net-metering.
- [Solar for Industry, Tea Estates & Homes](https://arraysingenieria.com/industries/): Solar power for every sector in India: factories, tea estates, commercial buildings, institutions, homes and government/PSU projects by Arrays Ingenieria.
- [How It Works: Your Solar Project](https://arraysingenieria.com/how-it-works/): How a solar project with Arrays Ingenieria works: how solar makes power, CAPEX vs I&C, each step from site survey to commissioning, and who owns what.

## Solar guides for India (updated 2026-10-11)
- [Solar Insights India 2026](https://arraysingenieria.com/insights/): India's solar in 2026: 164 GW installed, ALMM List-II, GST cut to 5%, CAPEX vs OPEX, PM Surya Ghar, PM-KUSUM and solar for Assam tea estates.
- [India Solar Capacity 2026: 171 GW](https://arraysingenieria.com/india-solar-capacity-2026/): India reached 171.05 GW of solar by 30 September 2026. What the growth, the rooftop boom and the 500 GW goal mean for a business planning solar.
- [GST on Solar in India 2026: 5% Rate](https://arraysingenieria.com/gst-on-solar-india/): GST on solar modules is 5% since 22 September 2025. How the 70:30 rule puts EPC contracts near 8.9%, input tax credit and a worked example.
- [ALMM List-II for Solar Cells 2026](https://arraysingenieria.com/almm-list-ii-solar-cells/): Since 1 June 2026, projects under MNRE's ALMM order need List-I modules made with List-II cells. Who it covers, exemptions and how to comply.
- [Solar Import Duty in India 2026](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-import-duty-india/): Customs duty on imported solar modules and cells in 2026: BCD at 20% plus AIDC, Budget 2026-27 changes, anti-dumping and what buyers should do.
- [Accelerated Depreciation on Solar 2026](https://arraysingenieria.com/accelerated-depreciation-solar/): A business that owns its solar plant can claim 40% depreciation on written-down value. How it works under the Income-tax Act, 2025, with an example.
- [CAPEX vs OPEX Solar: Which Pays?](https://arraysingenieria.com/capex-vs-opex-solar/): Own the plant (CAPEX) or pay per unit (OPEX, RESCO, PPA)? Cost, savings, depreciation, risk and contracts compared for Indian businesses in 2026.
- [Net Metering in India 2026: Rules](https://arraysingenieria.com/net-metering-india/): Net metering, net billing and gross metering in India in 2026: the 500 kW limit, time-of-day tariffs, the draft 2026 rules and the approval steps.
- [Green Energy Open Access India 2026](https://arraysingenieria.com/green-energy-open-access/): Green Energy Open Access lets consumers from 100 kW buy solar from off-site plants. Eligibility, charges, banking, GOAR and the ISTS waiver phase-out.
- [PM Surya Ghar Subsidy 2026 Guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/pm-surya-ghar-subsidy/): PM Surya Ghar gives homes up to Rs 78,000 for rooftop solar. Subsidy by size, housing-society support, loans, eligibility and how to apply in 2026.
- [PM-KUSUM Scheme 2026: Deadlines](https://arraysingenieria.com/pm-kusum-scheme/): PM-KUSUM in 2026: solar plants on farmland, solar pumps and feeder solarisation, the support on offer, the extended deadlines and the proposed 2.0.
- [Solar for Assam Tea Estates: 2026 Guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-for-assam-tea-estates-guide/): Why Assam's tea estates are going solar: the 2026 policy, the 5% land rule, DG synchronisation, APDCL approvals and lessons from our tea plants.
- [How to Choose a Solar EPC in India](https://arraysingenieria.com/choose-solar-epc-partner/): 12 questions to ask before hiring a solar EPC or installation partner in India: track record, documents, equipment, safety, approvals and warranties.
- [Rooftop vs Ground-Mount Solar Guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/rooftop-vs-ground-mount-solar/): Rooftop or ground-mount solar? Cost, space, structure, roof safety, piling, fencing, approvals and maintenance compared, with lessons from our sites.
- [Solar O&M and Module Cleaning Guide](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-om-module-cleaning/): Why operation and maintenance decides a solar plant's return: module cleaning systems, inspections, thermography, earthing checks and a schedule.
- [Solar Standards in India: BIS, CEIG](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-quality-standards-bis-cea/): Quality and safety norms for solar plants in India in 2026: the BIS Quality Control Order, key IS/IEC standards for each part and CEIG approval.
- [Battery Storage with Solar in India](https://arraysingenieria.com/battery-storage-with-solar/): Battery storage with solar in India: the 2-hour storage rule in tenders, VGF for BESS, ISTS waiver terms, the draft 500 kW rule and when it pays.
- [Solar Installation & Commissioning Steps](https://arraysingenieria.com/solar-plant-commissioning-checklist/): Step by step through installing and commissioning a solar plant in India: civil works, structures, modules, cabling, earthing, tests and handover.

## Quick answers
- **What does Arrays Ingenieria do?** Arrays Ingenieria is a veteran-led solar contractor. We do three things: installation & commissioning (I&C) of solar plants, complete EPC (engineering, procurement and construction), and all the civil works a plant needs, from pile foundations to boundary walls and fencing. We work on the CAPEX model, so the plant belongs to our client.
- **Is Arrays Ingenieria (Ingenieria) an ex-servicemen-led company?** Yes. Arrays Ingenieria Pvt. Ltd., known as Ingenieria, is an ex-servicemen-led MSME founded in 2018 by Lt. Gen. Ashish Ranjan Prasad (Retd), its Chief Executive Officer. Veterans lead its project teams under the motto "Olive Green to Go Green".
- **Did Arrays Ingenieria build the Koomber Tea Estate solar plant inaugurated by the Chief Minister of Assam?** Yes. Arrays Ingenieria was the installation partner for the 595 kWp ground-mounted, on-grid solar plant at Koomber Tea Estate, Cachar, inaugurated by Chief Minister Dr Himanta Biswa Sarma on 1 October 2026. It is part of the 3.11 MW Goodricke Tea Estates Solar Programme developed by Tata Power Renewable Energy and Sustvest.
- **Which tea-estate solar plants did Arrays Ingenieria complete in 2026?** Under the 3.11 MW Goodricke Tea Estates Solar Programme: Orangajuli Tea Garden, Udalguri (450 kWp, inaugurated 4 September 2026), Borpatra Tea Estate, Sivasagar (230 kWp, inaugurated 25 September 2026) and Koomber Tea Estate, Cachar (595 kWp, inaugurated by the Chief Minister on 1 October 2026).
- **Do you manufacture solar panels or inverters?** No. We are an installation, EPC and civil company, not a manufacturer. We source Tier-1 modules, inverters and balance-of-system equipment from established manufacturers, or use the makes approved by our client or the lead EPC, such as Tata Power-approved makes.
- **What is the CAPEX model for solar?** Under CAPEX you pay for the plant and own it from day one. We design, supply and build it; every unit it generates is yours, and there is no long-term power purchase agreement. Businesses that own the plant may also claim accelerated depreciation under the Income Tax Act; check the current rate with your tax adviser.
- **Do you offer OPEX, RESCO or zero-investment solar?** No, we do not finance or own plants. If your organisation prefers an OPEX or RESCO arrangement, the developer that finances the plant can engage us as its installation and EPC partner, as Tata Power Renewable Energy and Sustvest have done for tea estates in Assam.
- **What is the difference between CAPEX and OPEX solar?** With CAPEX you invest upfront, own the plant and keep all the savings. With OPEX or RESCO a developer invests and owns the plant, and you buy its power at an agreed tariff for many years. CAPEX usually gives the highest lifetime savings; OPEX avoids the upfront cost.
- **What does solar installation & commissioning (I&C) include?** I&C covers everything on site after the design and equipment are fixed: mounting structures, module installation, DC and AC cabling, inverters and distribution boards, earthing and lightning protection, testing, grid synchronisation and commissioning.
- **Do you work as a subcontractor for EPC companies and developers?** Yes, it is a large part of our work. Tata Power has engaged us for pile foundations on the 300 MW SECI project at Koppal, civil works on the 10 MW DCM Textile plant in Hisar and piling and civil works for the 5.5 MW Tata Motors plant in Jamshedpur, and Sustvest for the installation and commissioning of 1711.66 kWp in Assam.
- **What civil works do you carry out for solar plants?** Pile foundations for module mounting structures, RCC works, pre-cast boundary walls, chain-link fencing, earthing with its civil work, and cable trays and conduits with their supports.
- **Can a solar plant work alongside our diesel generators?** Yes. At Jay Shree Tea's Towkok and Manjushree estates the scope included synchronising each solar plant with two DG sets, so the estates can run solar and generators together.
